# Digital Marketing Bureau (DMB)

> DMB stands for Digital Marketing Bureau, an India-based digital marketing and performance marketing agency led by Parmjeet Singh. Services include SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media, landing pages and measurement. Public information is available in English.

## Business information
- Website: https://dmbureau.cloud
- Email: connect@dmbureau.cloud
- Phone: +91 94101 74200
- Delivery: based in India; remote services across the countries listed below. Country pages describe service markets and do not imply local offices.
- Work and fees are agreed before starting. No guaranteed rankings, sales, AI citations or performance scores.

## Core pages
- [About](https://dmbureau.cloud/about): who we are and how we work.
- [Services](https://dmbureau.cloud/services): service scopes and next steps.
- [Industries](https://dmbureau.cloud/industries): plans for different business types.
- [Markets](https://dmbureau.cloud/markets): delivery context for target countries.
- [Blog](https://dmbureau.cloud/blog): practical marketing guides.
